.Correspondence notes and residual assumptions (§2.2)

`eval-ext`:: Same proposition: states agreeing on every free variable give equal values.
* Variables are ℕ in Agda and String in Lean; integers are the stdlib ℤ and core Int. Compared up to that encoding.

`eval-independent`:: Same proposition.
* Variables are ℕ in Agda and String in Lean; integers are the stdlib ℤ and core Int. Compared up to that encoding.

`rev-forward-backward-add`:: Same proposition, full state (∀ y). The older Lean rev_forward_backward is its restriction to y = x.
* Variables are ℕ in Agda and String in Lean; integers are the stdlib ℤ and core Int. Compared up to that encoding.

`rev-forward-backward-sub`:: Same proposition, full state. Lean writes σ x - v, Agda σ x + (- v); Int.sub is defined as addition of the negation.
* Variables are ℕ in Agda and String in Lean; integers are the stdlib ℤ and core Int. Compared up to that encoding.

`rev-forward-backward-with-token`:: Same proposition. Lean quantifies over op with hop : op = addAssign x e; Agda states addAssign directly.
* Variables are ℕ in Agda and String in Lean; integers are the stdlib ℤ and core Int. Compared up to that encoding.

`rev-forward-backward-with-token-sub`:: Same proposition.
* Variables are ℕ in Agda and String in Lean; integers are the stdlib ℤ and core Int. Compared up to that encoding.

`naive-backward-fails-self-ref`:: Both existential with x ∈ freeVars e and recovery failing at x; witnesses differ only in variable name (zero vs "x").
* Variables are ℕ in Agda and String in Lean; integers are the stdlib ℤ and core Int. Compared up to that encoding.

`join-idem`:: Same proposition.
* Echo is the same three-constructor type in both; join and the two policies were compared case by case.

`join-comm`:: Same proposition.
* Echo is the same three-constructor type in both; join and the two policies were compared case by case.

`join-assoc`:: Same proposition.
* Echo is the same three-constructor type in both; join and the two policies were compared case by case.

`join-unit`:: Same proposition (left unit).
* Echo is the same three-constructor type in both; join and the two policies were compared case by case.

`join-absorbing`:: Same proposition (right absorption).
* Echo is the same three-constructor type in both; join and the two policies were compared case by case.

`order-is-join-order`:: Lean defines ≤ as a ⊔ b = b, so its statement holds by definition; Agda defines ⊑ independently and proves both directions.
* Echo is the same three-constructor type in both; join and the two policies were compared case by case.

`admissibleWithResidue-iff`:: Agda states the right side as e ≡ Safe ⊎ e ≡ Neutral, Lean as e ≠ breaking; equivalent on the three-element type.
* Echo is the same three-constructor type in both; join and the two policies were compared case by case.

`admissible-implies-residue`:: Same proposition.
* Echo is the same three-constructor type in both; join and the two policies were compared case by case.

`token-buys-neutral`:: Same conjunction.
* Echo is the same three-constructor type in both; join and the two policies were compared case by case.

`join-admissible`:: Same proposition.
* Echo is the same three-constructor type in both; join and the two policies were compared case by case.

`join-admissibleWithResidue`:: Same proposition.
* Echo is the same three-constructor type in both; join and the two policies were compared case by case.

`blockEcho-admissible`:: Same proposition; both fold join from Safe.
* Echo is the same three-constructor type in both; join and the two policies were compared case by case.

`blockEcho-admissibleWithResidue`:: Same proposition.
* Echo is the same three-constructor type in both; join and the two policies were compared case by case.

`fibre-inputs-agree`:: Same proposition. Agda's fibre is a Σ-type, Lean's a subtype.
* Fibre representation differs (Σ vs subtype); compared on first components only.

`loss-is-real`:: Not the same statement: Agda exhibits two inputs of a fixed constant map Bool → Bool; Lean states ∃ f : Bool → Unit with two distinct fibre witnesses. Agda's implies a statement of Lean's form, not the converse.
* Different witness maps; the Lean statement is the weaker existential.

`tokenless-conditional-not-identity`:: Same existential; the guard tests variable zero in Agda and "x" in Lean.
* Variables are ℕ in Agda and String in Lean; integers are the stdlib ℤ and core Int. Compared up to that encoding.

`reversible-if-with-residue`:: Same proposition. Overwriting branches are out of scope in both.
* Variables are ℕ in Agda and String in Lean; integers are the stdlib ℤ and core Int. Compared up to that encoding.

`data-totality`:: Lean only. A structural-recursion statement; no Agda source yet.
